blind.description: A stylized fantasy-style smelting furnace or bloomery. It features a conical terracotta/clay body reinforced with three dark iron bands, set atop a square stepped stone block foundation. At the front is an arched taphole opening with a short stone trough filled with rounded ore chunks or slag pebbles. A cylindrical pipe or tuyere projects from the right side for airflow. The chimney stack opens at the top. The surfaces are solid and fully modeled with stylized, hand-painted textures featuring orange-brown clay, dark soot streaks, and mossy grey-green stone base blocks.
blind.from_above: A circular open chimney hole surrounded by the concentric banded clay cone, resting on a square stone masonry plinth, with an outflow chute protruding at the bottom and a cylindrical pipe extending to the right.
blind.extra_base_or_ground: square stone block foundation plinth integrated into the structure
blind.height_vs_figure: About the same height as the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 5.5 to 6 ft tall), with a footprint about 4 ft wide by 4 ft deep.
